text:
morgan: Heads-up — we're planning a cutover next week for SIEM exports and retention tiers. Raw event retention moves from 365d -> 180d, with a masked/live-view tier for 2 years. Need alignment on RBAC changes + KMS unwrap for triage.
sam: Ack. Can you share the exact scope? which streams (auth, infra, app) and exporters? :thinking_face:
natalie: This affects splunk-forwarder -> splunk-indexer streaming and the archival S3 export consumers. Auth and infra are high risk for investigations.
incident-bot: Incident policy reminder: any decrypted snapshot used for investigations must have an approval ticket attached and TTL <= 24h unless elevated by SOC lead.
alex: For RBAC, proposal: create role security:siem_view_masked (read masked views), security:siem_raw_view (forensics, timeboxed). Grant raw only to SOC, IR, and approved SREs during triage.
devops: KMS question — exports are envelope-encrypted with customer-CMKs? Or a single org CMK? Need to know to scope rotation impact.
morgan: Org CMK for now. Plan is to wrap daily export bundles with the org CMK and store in encrypted S3. For incident triage we want a JIT unwrap flow (ticket -> approval -> short-lived unwrap token) instead of granting long-lived key access.
sam: Sounds good. Who runs the approval? manual via the ticketing UI or automated (PD escalation)?
chris: We should automate: ticket created in Zendesk with required fields (incident id, justification, time range, requestor, TTL). Then OPA policy checks attributes and if permitted, PagerDuty flow triggers SOC lead approval or auto-approve for low-risk reviewers.
natalie: Example ticket body we discussed:
```
Title: Request unwrap - export 2026-03-18
Fields:
- Requestor: <name>
- Incident: IR-2026-032
- Streams: auth, infra
- Time range: 2026-03-17 02:00 -> 2026-03-18 06:00
- Justification: failed login burst correlated with vulnerability scan
- TTL: 8h
```
alex: Implementation note: unwrap API should return a presigned S3 URL valid for TTL and require an unwrap token bound to the ticket id. No key material ever exposed in logs.
sre-oncall: For incident response playbooks, require that any raw log snapshot is imported into a temporary forensic enclave that is ephemeral and logged to audit (no copying out). The enclave's service account must be different from regular analyst accounts.
legal: Confirming retention/forensics: masked view (2y) okay for legal discovery, but for e-discovery we need to ensure preserved copies can be held longer under legal hold. We'll need a hold flag mechanism that prevents deletion and exempt rotation until cleared.
morgan: Good catch — we'll add a hold API: /holds/{id}/preserve which toggles retention override and requires legal approval and audit trail.
devops: One more ops detail: streaming consumers must be flagged as "export-sensitive" to prevent accidental forwarding. Add an env var or tag on the kinesis/splunk consumer groups.
chris: RBAC change rollout plan:
- Phase 0: create roles and policy docs in repo
- Phase 1: grant masked role org-wide, raw role to a small pilot of SOC
- Phase 2: enable JIT unwrap and remove broad raw grants
- Phase 3: full cutover and audit
morgan: Timeline: target Tuesday midnight cutover to new retention config. Pilot for SOC start Monday. Need console banner + API deprecation notes + runbook for SOC.
sam: Who owns the runbook and the unwrap API? I can take runbook; alex can you own unwrap API + presigned flow?
alex: Yes, I’ll own unwrap API. Devops can add consumer tagging and S3 lifecycle rules.
devops: Taking consumer tagging and lifecycle rules.
natalie: Quick vuln triage ask — if we block raw-view access, how do SRE triage emergent kernel panic logs that only land in raw? We need emergency bypass that still logs and requires a PD escalation.
sre-oncall: Emergency bypass: PD escalation -> SOC lead approves -> devs get a scoped unwrap token for 1h. Every bypass must create a ticket with postmortem within 48h.
legal: Add requirement: all bypasses get copied to the legal hold queue so counsel can review if needed.
morgan: OK. Action items: @alex implement unwrap API + token binding; @devops add consumer tags & S3 lifecycle; @sam write SOC runbook with ticket template; @legal finalize hold workflow; @natalie draft pilot permission spreadsheet. I'll post the console banner draft today.
chris: minor: ensure audit logs include key unwrap events, ticket id, approver, and presigned URL issuance event id (not the URL itself) — redact any tokens in logs.
alex: Will log event ids only. No token or presigned URLs in central logs.
morgan: Thanks all. If anyone sees compliance gaps ping me. :thumbsup:
